# Examine temporal paths from 1010 to 883 in window [69317, 71717] with max gap 600
window = (69317, 71717)
start_node = 1010
target_node = 883
max_gap = 600

# events variable is available
wstart, wend = window
# filter events in window
wevents = [e for e in events if wstart <= e[2] <= wend]
print(f"Total events in window: {len(wevents)}")

# list events involving 1010 or 883
involved = [e for e in wevents if e[0] in (start_node, target_node) or e[1] in (start_node, target_node)]
print(f"Events involving 1010 or 883 in window: {len(involved)}")
for e in involved:
    print(e)

# Build index by source for events in window
from collections import defaultdict, deque
src_index = defaultdict(list)
for u,v,t in wevents:
    src_index[u].append((u,v,t))
# sort lists by time
for u in src_index:
    src_index[u].sort(key=lambda x: x[2])

# BFS over temporal edges: state is (node, time, path)
paths = []
# initial events: events where u==start_node
initials = [e for e in wevents if e[0]==start_node]
print(f"Initial events where {start_node} acted: {len(initials)}")
for e in initials:
    # each initial is a path of one interaction
    u,v,t = e
    if v==target_node:
        paths.append([e])
    else:
        # BFS from this event
        queue = deque()
        queue.append((v,t,[e]))
        visited = set()  # (node,time) to avoid cycles
        visited.add((v,t))
        while queue:
            node, time, path = queue.popleft()
            # look for events with source == node with t2>time and t2-time<=max_gap
            for (su,sv,st) in src_index.get(node, []):
                if st>time and st-time<=max_gap:
                    newpath = path+[(su,sv,st)]
                    if sv==target_node:
                        paths.append(newpath)
                    else:
                        key=(sv,st)
                        if key not in visited:
                            visited.add(key)
                            queue.append((sv,st,newpath))

print(f"Found {len(paths)} temporal paths from {start_node} to {target_node} within window and max_gap {max_gap}")
# print up to 20 paths
for i,p in enumerate(paths[:20]):
    print(f"Path {i+1} (len {len(p)}):", p)

# Also check if there's any undirected connection when time ignored between 1010 and 883 within window
# Build undirected graph of interactions in window
nodes = set()
adj = defaultdict(set)
for u,v,t in wevents:
    nodes.add(u); nodes.add(v)
    adj[u].add(v); adj[v].add(u)

# BFS undirected from 1010 to 883
found=False
from collections import deque
q=deque([start_node]); seen={start_node}
while q:
    n=q.popleft()
    if n==target_node:
        found=True; break
    for nb in adj[n]:
        if nb not in seen:
            seen.add(nb); q.append(nb)
print('Undirected connectivity between 1010 and 883 in window:', found)

# Print degrees for nodes in window
deg = {n: len(adj[n]) for n in adj}
print('Degree of 1010:', deg.get(start_node,0))
print('Degree of 883:', deg.get(target_node,0))

# For completeness, print all events in window (count first)
